cards.title: Received webhook
cards.signature: func (c *<Vendor>WebhookController) Store(ctx *hhttp.Context) error
calledBy: the router, under a path CSRFExcept exempts in bootstrap/app.go
may: 1. verify the signature over the raw body with webhook.Verify, before binding anything
2. bind the request from the same bytes
3. hand it to a service that stores an event in the outbox, inside database.Transaction, under the delivery id
4. answer 2xx; a listener does the processing after the commit
mayNot: process the payload in the request
dispatch a job from the service: a job whose handler takes services imports app/Services, so a service importing app/Jobs is an import cycle
cards.errors: a bad signature is refused before anything is recorded

recipes.name: crud
recipes.title: CRUD of an entity
steps: aru make:module <name> --fields "title:string!,amount:money" --tenant
paste the wiring it printed into bootstrap/app.go and routes/web.go
aru model:build, aru view:build
run the project's gates

recipes.name: action
recipes.title: An action outside CRUD (publish, close)
steps: write the transition as a rule of the entity, in the model's custom block
add a use case to the service: load with the read Grant, authorize, apply the rule, persist
add the action as a method of the resource's controller
register it: aru make:controller <Entity> --action=<name> prints r.ResourceAction("POST", ...)

recipes.name: invokable
recipes.title: A single-action controller
steps: aru make:controller <Name> --invokable
register it with r.Invokable

recipes.name: nested
recipes.title: A resource nested under another
steps: aru make:module <name> --fields "..." --parent=<resource>
register it with r.Resource("projects.tasks", c), shallow by default
the service loads the parent through the parent's policy and filters the child by it

recipes.name: report
recipes.title: A report or read model
steps: write app/Repositories/<Name>Repository.go, every method taking the Grant
call it from a service that authorizes first

recipes.name: job
recipes.title: Background work
steps: aru make:job <Name> --fields "invoice_id:uuid"
register the handler in the handler catalogue the worker reads
dispatch it from the service with the Grant it already holds
schedule it in routes/console.go when it runs on a clock

recipes.name: command
recipes.title: A console command
steps: aru make:command <Name> --signature=invoice:close
register it in routes/console.go

recipes.name: listener
recipes.title: Reacting to a fact
steps: aru make:event <Name> --aggregate=<entity>
aru make:listener <Name> --event=<entity>.<fact>
record the event in the service's write; the outbox delivers it

recipes.name: webhook
recipes.title: A received webhook
steps: aru make:controller <Vendor>Webhook: one action that verifies the signature over the raw body with webhook.Verify before anything else, on a route under a prefix CSRFExcept exempts in bootstrap/app.go

aru make:event <Vendor><Fact> --aggregate=<vendor>_delivery: the service the controller hands the delivery to stores it with outbox.Store inside database.Transaction, under the delivery id, as the command prints

aru make:listener <Name> --event=<vendor>_delivery.<fact>: add it to listeners.Each in bootstrap/app.go; it does the processing after the commit, retried by the relay, and keys on the delivery id because delivery is at-least-once
the controller answers 2xx as soon as the event is stored; the service dispatches no job, because app/Jobs imports app/Services once a handler takes a service and the reverse import is a cycle

recipes.name: integration
recipes.title: An external system
steps: aru make:client <Vendor>: config, interface, client, fake and test
hand the client to the service's constructor in bootstrap/app.go
tests use the fake; the service never sees the network
a client more than one project needs becomes an hyz-is/arandu-* module

recipes.name: mcp
recipes.title: Exposing the application to an assistant
steps: aru make:mcp-tool <Name> --service=<Entity>
add the tool to the server mounted in routes/web.go
